# Muscleheadon — The Superhuman Club

> Muscleheadon (Muscleheadon Health and Fitness Pvt Ltd) runs The Superhuman Club, a premium fitness and biohacking club founded by Naveen Chandra Kulkarni, with clubs in Bandra West (Mumbai) and Nagpur, and online coaching across India.

The Superhuman Club coaches every member across six pillars — Workout, Nutrition, Supplements, Wellness, Clinical and Recovery — with the Mind at the centre, connected to every pillar. Members are measured where they start, given a programme that fits their life, and re-measured every 90 days.

## Key facts
- Founder: Naveen Chandra Kulkarni (also Naveen Kulkarni). 12+ years in fitness. ACE and Precision Nutrition certified. Competed at Mr. Olympia (Las Vegas) and the Dubai Muscle Show. Path: health café → fitness studio → transformation studio → The Superhuman Club.
- Bandra West, Mumbai: corner of 24th & 33rd Road, off Linking Road, Bandra West, Mumbai 400052.
- Nagpur: Punyai Apartment, Plot 217, Bajaj Nagar, Nagpur 440010.
- Online: coaching anywhere in India.
- Phone: +91 89999 01473 · Instagram: @muscleheadon
